near_misses.title: Colourful sunrise likely tomorrow 7:14am
near_misses.body: 28% odds of colour. Best bets: Peter Iredale shipwreck (Fort Stevens), Vancouver Lake & Shillapoo wildlife areas, Frenchman's Bar Park (dawn goose & crane flyover). Horizon toward the sun is 50% open.
why: 37% chance of a colourful sunrise sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the rising sun 50% open (25–300 km)
